title: Gate native capability adoption on quality, scope and independent readiness
summary: Callable native APIs are not sufficient default providers: validate quality, original data scope, OCR geometry, total deadlines and per-capability assets before adoption.
reusable_steps: Callable native APIs are not sufficient default providers: validate quality, original data scope, OCR geometry, total deadlines and per-capability assets before adoption
expected_outcome:
Applicability: host-native inference, OCR and speech integration into shared Kyberion workflows.

1. Separate compilation support, runtime capability, asset readiness, authority and task quality. Check representative public inputs against visible facts before changing defaults. A caption that invents UI state stays explicitly experimental; preserve configured reasoning for detailed screen interpretation. Prompt constraints alone are not a quality gate.

2. Cache native OCR executables instead of interpreting Swift per image. Keep real line confidence and normalized top-left boxes for redaction. Validate finite geometry and exact text/line coverage; reject malformed results as a whole. Do not claim geometry-complete OCR from text-only legacy output.

3. Share one deadline across compilation, inference and fallback. Never start fallback after cancellation or budget exhaustion. Preserve explicit languages; normalize legacy aliases/case/separators without silently substituting English.

4. Authorize the original image before provider selection or preparation. Derive sensitivity and tenant ownership from lexical and canonical paths. Tenant-owned sources require matching active or declared scope; retain owner and tier in output directories and reasoning payload. Reject cross-tenant or lower-tier copies even for unscoped trusted callers. Public redacted copies do not lower the source tier. Policy and redaction failures stop both local and remote fallback.

5. Probe SpeechAnalyzer independently of text-model availability. Supported/downloading assets are not installed readiness. Cache by locale, honor opt-out first, preserve explicit STT configuration and never download/reserve assets during metadata probes.

Record known limits separately. These checks do not assert full native-lane live acceptance, installed speech assets, production-quality native captions or untested host-action success.
